content: sam_hdr_dup (65 lines): deep-copies a bam_hdr_t including text, target arrays, and internal hash tables. sam_hdr_destroy (24 lines): refcounted free. Currently used in HeaderView Clone and Drop. Replacing these requires either: (1) owning the header data in Rust (Vec<u8> for text, Vec<String> for target names) and only keeping the C struct for FFI compatibility, or (2) full Rust header struct. The caches we added (tid_by_name HashMap) already duplicate some of this. This is the path toward a fully Rust-owned HeaderView.
